title: pokerface.lock.yaml v0.1
description: The metadata written back after a successful build and push (docs/spec/pokerface-lock.md). The implementation adds the cross-entry rules the schema cannot express: no two images may share a name, no duplicate tags inside an entry, and generated_at never participates in digest verification.

commit.description: The full 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA the images were built from.

source.description: The repository the images were built from, <host>/<owner>/<repo> after normalization; a ref is rejected.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, informational only. The generator leaves it empty for byte-stable rebuilds.

items.description: Already-rendered OCI tags — placeholders belong in pokerface.yaml.

digest.description: The index digest for a multi-platform build, the manifest digest otherwise.

manifest_digest.description: The selected platform's manifest digest; absent means same as digest.
